Tia (Customer): Hey @support — our embedding calls started failing this morning after we switched to eu region. Getting `dimension mismatch` errors and some requests are super slow (~5-8s). Request id: r-0a9f3e. Any idea?

Alex S: Hi Tia, sorry about that — can you paste the request body (or a sanitized version) and the exact error payload? Also which endpoint URL you hit? eu-west-1 or eu-central?

Tia (Customer): We hit `https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings?region=eu-west-1`. Body is basically: `{ "model": "open-embed-002", "input": [[0.1,0.2,...]], "user_id": "acct-77" }` — we do batched inputs (sometimes arrays of 16). Error reply: `400 Bad Request {"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024"}`. We don't think our client changed. This started after ~06:12 UTC.

Alex S: Thanks — dimension mismatch implies model variant served in that region expects a different embedding dim. Two hypotheses: 1) routing to a different model family in eu region (e.g., quantized/legacy) 2) stale model config in regional cache. Can you share the raw response headers (esp x-rw-instance, x-rw-region-route, x-rw-model)? those are in curl -i output.

Tia (Customer): Sure, here's trimmed headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
x-rw-instance: embed-eu-12
x-rw-region-route: eu-west-1 -> us-west-2
x-rw-model: open-embed-002:v1
x-rw-request-id: r-0a9f3e
```

Tia (Customer): Notice the region route shows -> us-west-2. Why would eu route to us west?

Alex S: Ah, that explains it. If eu routing forwarded to a us-west instance hosting a different model variant, you'd get dim mismatch. Maria / Jon can you check the region routing map and capacity spillover rules around 06:00-06:30 UTC? Possible cold-start spillover or mis-labeled model artifact.

Maria I: I'm on it. Looking at routing logs — we had an autoscaler cold-start event for `embed-eu-pool` at 06:11 UTC; traffic spike from a partner job. The routing policy has fallback-to-any-available for embeddings when pool is exhausted. I can see requests were routed to `us-west-2` reserve pool which currently hosts `open-embed-002:v0` (1024 dim). So it was a spillover + model mismatch.

Jon P: Adding context: we recently rolled `open-embed-002:v1` with 1536 dims to eu pools, but the regional fallback mapping wasn't updated to prefer v1 for embeddings. The global fallback index still lists `open-embed-002:v0` as compatible. So when eu exhausted capacity, it spilled to us-west which runs v0. That's a config bug in the compatibility matrix.

Alex S: Ok — immediate mitigation steps we can do for Tia: 1) pin requests to eu region explicitly (they already did) but ensure `region` header/param is enforced to block cross-region fallback until we patch; 2) temporary server-side hotfix: mark `open-embed-002:v0` as incompatible for eu routing so spillover avoids it. Tia, do you want us to block cross-region fallbacks for your account until resolved?

Tia (Customer): Yes please block cross-region fallback for acct-77. We prefer failures > wrong vectors.

Maria I: I can apply a blacklist for acct-77 at the routing layer now. Pushing a quick rule: `route.allow_spillover=false` for acct-77. Deploying...

deploy-bot: deploy started for routing-blacklist/acct-77 @ 2026-03-15T07:05:12Z

Maria I: Deployed. Tia can you retry?

Tia (Customer): Retried — now I get `503 Service Unavailable` with header `x-rw-error: region-no-capacity` and request id r-0a9f3e-2. No dimension mismatch, thanks. Slightly slower but at least consistent.

Alex S: Good. Now for the root cause: Jon, can you describe the fix timeline for the compatibility matrix and fallback policy? We need to ensure fallback candidates are model-dim-compatible and ideally prefer same-region or same-variant.

Jon P: Plan: 1) patch the compatibility index to reflect dims per variant (rolling patch 1 hr), 2) change fallback policy to check `model_dim == requested_dim` before routing (hotfix in 2-4 hrs), 3) add a metric `routing.spillover.count` per model-variant to detect regressions (1 day). I'll own 1 & 2.

Maria I: Also we'll increase eu pool burst capacity and pre-warm a small pool to avoid cold starts during partner job windows. Scheduling scaling window from 05:50-06:30 UTC daily as a short-term mitigation.

Alex S: Support action items: 1) Block cross-region fallback for acct-77 (done). 2) Send customer summary and ETA for full fix (I'll draft). 3) Suggest clients include `x-rw-expected-dim` header as a temporary safety check — engineering, can we surface this header in docs?

Jon P: `x-rw-expected-dim` is fine as a short-term safety header, we'll add server-side validation rule to reject incompatible requests with explicit error code `422 dimension_mismatch_client` if header present. Will follow up in PR.

Tia (Customer): Appreciate the quick help. One more ask: can you provide a short repro we can run locally so we can spot this earlier?

Alex S: Repro steps for customers: 1) Send a batched embeddings request with expected-dim header to eu endpoint. Example:
```
curl -i -X POST 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings?region=eu-west-1' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \
  -H 'x-rw-expected-dim: 1536' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-002","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
If you get `400 dimension mismatch` without expected-dim header, or `503 region-no-capacity` after we block spillover, that's consistent with our scenarios.

Maria I: Internal repro (infra): run a synthetic load to exhaust `embed-eu-pool` then send a request that prefers v1. I can share a k8s job snippet if needed.

Jon P: I'll open PRs: compatibility-index patch (PR#4501), fallback-check (PR#4502). Target merge in 2 hours, rollout in progressive canary across regions (eu -> us).

Alex S: I'll send the customer a timeline and the temporary mitigation summary. Tia, expecting to follow up within 2 hours with ETA for permanent fix.

Tia (Customer): Sounds good. Thanks everyone :heart:

Alex S: Summary & next steps for the thread: - Immediate: account-level spillover blacklist applied (Maria) - Short-term: block cross-region fallback for acct-77 (done) - Mid-term (2-4h): compatibility index + fallback-dim-check (Jon) - Operational: pre-warm eu pool and scaling windows (Maria) - Docs: recommend `x-rw-expected-dim` header and example snippet (Alex/Jon)

Jon P: I'll update PRs and ping here when merged.

Maria I: Adding an alert to routing dashboards: `alert: embedding_spillover_high` if spillover rate > 1% for >5m.

Alex S: Closing loop after PRs merged and customer notified. Tagging for postmortem if we see recurrence.

deploy-bot: PR merged routing-blacklist acct-77 @ 2026-03-15T08:02:43Z

Alex S: Thanks team — moving to resolved for now, will reopen if Tia reports any regressions.

Tia (Customer): Confirmed fixed on our side. Closing the loop.
